fields.description: Issue includes political commentary and reader coupons opposing or supporting a Florida sales tax; reporting and editorial discussion of alleged graft in FHA housing projects and concerns about overbuilding and rental housing in Miami; coverage of a court matter involving Dr. Moore and related criminal proceedings; hurricane-preparedness guidance attributed to the Dade County Red Cross; local court and policing items (traffic court cases and discussion of night officers required to appear in day court); nightlife and entertainment columns and listings; and a "Matrimony Row" section summarizing divorce filings and domestic disputes.
